message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. The first blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so neither admin_dc nor admin_adfs can become true. The second then blocks authentication to DB, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if CI leaks database credentials. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI credential-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation. Any other single control leaves the phishing → internal access → application authentication → kerberoasting → DC administration → database exfiltration route available, since stolen_admin bypasses application-server patches and endpoint footholds bypass mfa:user."}
